scientific_integrity: The formulas are derived by exact grading and associative-splitting arguments; no independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform result for positive one-variable Novikov truncations, not all Novikov algebras. The 2003 low-dimensional automorphism article could not be fully inspected, and absolute priority is uncertain. Finite-rank checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
title: Derivation dimensions of positive truncated Novikov algebras and a mod-four exceptional direction
